question: As of March 14, 2024, which of the following is the world's highest railway bridge?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chenab Bridge**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chenab Bridge** is the **world's highest railway bridge**, located in the Reasi district of Jammu and Kashmir, India. It stands at an incredible height of **359 meters (1,178 feet)** above the riverbed.
 
• The bridge is part of the **Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link Project (USBRL)**, a crucial initiative to connect the Kashmir Valley with the Indian railway network.
 
• It is constructed over the **Chenab River** and spans a total length of **1,315 meters (4,314 feet)**, making it a remarkable feat of engineering.
